[BBC Business] Wise under investigation over money laundering control concerns
Wise says it is working with the Brussels prosecutor's office but that "no specific findings have been shared with us to date".

[BBC Business] AI giant Anthropic says it plans to list on US stock market
The AI company behind Claude is set to offer the public shares of stock sometime this year.

[BBC Business] Abusive passengers could be blacklisted from all airlines under new proposal
The scheme would allow airlines to share information on disruptive passengers and potentially restrict their access to flights.

[BBC Business] UK banks blocked from cyber AI tool Mythos get offer from rival OpenAI
Nine banks have been offered access to GPT 5.5 Cyber, as fierce rival Anthropic has blocked previews of its tool.

[CNBC] Trump tells CNBC: 'I don't care' if Iran negotiations are over
President Trump spoke with CNBC's Eamon Javers about the latest with the Iran war in an interview Monday.

[CNBC] Anthropic confidentially files IPO prospectus with SEC, prepping Wall Street for landmark AI deal
Anthropic said it confidentially filed its IPO prospectus with the SEC, setting up a potentially historic share sale for investors ready to jump into AI.

[CNBC] McDonald's unveils new global growth strategy to win over diners as competition rises
McDonald's new growth plan comes as inflation and high gas prices mean restaurants are competing for a smaller pool of customers.

[CNBC] SpaceX sets aside up to 5% of shares in IPO for certain employees and friends
In an updated IPO prospectus, SpaceX said that up to 5% of stock being offered by the company in the offering will be available in a direct share program.

[MarketWatch] Global oil prices trim early gains but still top $95 a barrel after Trump says peace talks with Iran are back on following a pause
Talks with Iran were “continuing, at a rapid pace,” and Israel and Hezbollah have agreed to stop attacking each other in Lebanon, President Trump said in a post on Truth Social Monday afternoon.

[MarketWatch] My golf buddy dropped me when I didn’t ask him to be my financial adviser. Was I naive?
“Friendliness alone is not a sufficient reason to trust someone with your finances.”

[MarketWatch] ‘I have no preexisting conditions’: I’m 56, earn $198,000 and want to retire early. Can I afford private healthcare?
“I’m trying to figure out whether it’s worth my while achieving FIRE.”

[MarketWatch] Did Trump spark an IBM stock rally? It’s complicated.
IBM’s strong stock momentum Monday comes as the software sector continues its comeback.
